definition: A label for a set of Chinese varieties that includes the basis of Standard Mandarin.
entry_text: A label for a set of Chinese varieties that includes the basis of Standard Mandarin.
example: A voice director requests a Standard Mandarin recording.
label: Mandarin
sense_note: Distinguish standard speech from the broader group.

sources.note: Original historical research distinguishes regional Mandarin varieties from the codified standard, explaining northern dialect and Beijing pronunciation inputs. Do not treat Mandarin as synonymous with all Chinese.
